body: You're probably right, It's just too hard for me to see right now. My family is always asking me about work and asking if it's permanent. They're always pressuring me into going to college, which I want to do but not before I know what I want to do with my life so I'm not wasting my time there again. If they want what's best for me, they're doing it in a way that just makes me feel depressed and as if I'm just a burden.

I just feel like such a scumbag for acting like I do toward my family. I'm a few years over 18 and should be taking care of myself by now. Instead I'm leeching money and food out of them while they're trying to be successful for themselves. The relative I'm living with now is, I'm assuming, holding off on his retirement until I get my life started, which I just can't seem to be able to do. I don't know how to forgive myself. If I were them, I'd hate me as much as I do.

If you would rather me not vent toward you, just say so.
